qualification_branch: After independent root raw admission, independently check the official Valve product/download page, exact-package US-English Google Play listing, lawful original channel, full-client blackbox source boundary, and unchanged APK SHA. Publisher-signer binding remains explicitly unproven unless Valve publishes a matching certificate fingerprint or signs the exact APK digest. Qualification requires separate peer and root decisions.
static_branch: After independent root raw admission, freeze a per-APK four-phase ZIP/metadata/ELF/DEX runner based on accepted G301/G298 host method. Its cache key must include APK SHA-256, exact scanner source SHA-256, rules/input SHA-256, venv manifest SHA-256 and readelf SHA-256. Only then record actual scan start/end, phase raw streams/rc, pre/post guards, independent postrun and root static admission. Static work may start before qualification ends if both branches retain the same APK SHA; it has no blackbox or startup count effect by itself.
